jobs.occupation: Global Head of Strategy & Real Estate (Fachwirt/in - Facility-Management)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

This is one of the most strategically significant roles in the new CREM structure — and in many respects the strategic right hand of the Head of CREM. As Head of Strategy & Real Estate, you will build and lead the capability that connects Merck's business direction to its global real estate portfolio: translating corporate strategy into actionable portfolio plans, owning the business partnering relationships with sector leadership, and overseeing the execution of transactions across EMEA, AMER and APAC.
This is a newly created function. Portfolio strategy, proactive planning and workplace strategy do not currently exist in a mature form within Merck's real estate organisation — you will establish them. Transactions capability exists and is largely retained; your mandate is to elevate it from reactive execution to strategically-led delivery.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Portfolio Strategy: Lead the development and annual refresh of CREM's Real Estate Plan of Record — translating business growth, consolidation and transformation requirements into a multi-year portfolio strategy with clear priorities, scenarios and business cases. Own portfolio optimisation as the function's primary strategic output.
- Business Partnering: Serve as a senior strategic partner to business sector leads across Healthcare, Life Science and Electronics — embedding CRE into business planning cycles before decisions are made, not after. Build trusted relationships that position CREM as a value-creating partner.
- M&A Support – Lead on all aspects of Real Estate and FM due diligence to support Merck M&A activity, managing cross-border due diligence and master planning to capture portfolio synergies, mitigate risk, and prepare portfolio integration plan. Once M&A transaction is signed then lead the implementation of all portfolio and service delivery integration activities.
- Workplace & Occupancy Strategy: Own workplace and occupancy planning strategy at a global level — setting standards, guiding space utilisation principles and ensuring portfolio decisions reflect both business needs and efficiency targets.
- Market Intelligence: Oversee the function's market intelligence capability — leveraging external partners and broker relationships to ensure portfolio decisions are backed by real market insight, proactive lease expiry management and benchmarked market data.
- Transaction Oversight: Provide strategic direction and oversight to the regional Transaction Managers across EMEA, AMER and APAC — ensuring all transactions are strategy-led, governed consistently and executed to a high standard. Maintain sufficient transaction expertise to provide cover and resource flexibility where needed.
- Portfolio Management Oversight: Direct the regional Portfolio Managers in building and maintaining portfolio performance visibility, opportunity identification and Plan of Record delivery across all geographies.
- Governance & Process: Champion the adoption of CREM's transaction and strategy governance frameworks — ensuring compliance with playbooks, approval processes and decision rights across the team. Responsible for approving all global real estate transactions above approved thresholds
- Stakeholder Engagement: Represent CREM in cross-functional forums alongside the Head of CREM — including OLC engagement, sector strategy sessions and M&A workstreams where real estate input is required.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 12+ years in corporate real estate, with a strong track record in portfolio strategy, location strategy or strategic business partnering at a senior level within a large multinational
- Demonstrated experience developing and owning portfolio strategy — scenario planning, multi-year planning, lease expiry management, location strategy
- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build and present compelling business cases to C-suite audiences
- Deep understanding of transaction management across leasehold and freehold assets; sufficient execution expertise to provide leadership continuity across the regional transaction teams
- Experience working in a matrixed, multi-sector corporate environment; comfortable navigating complex stakeholder landscapes
- Exceptional relationship builder — able to operate credibly at senior business and executive level
- Exposure to workplace strategy and occupancy planning advantageous
- Master's degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Finance or a related field
- Fluency in English required; additional languages advantageous given global remit

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Global Head of Facilities Management (Fachwirt/in - Facility-Management)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

One of the most operationally significant roles in the new CREM structure, the Global Head of Facilities Management is responsible for leading and transforming Merck's facilities and workplace management function across a global portfolio of 340+ locations and 4.3 million m² — encompassing offices, standalone labs, warehouses and selected soft services at manufacturing sites across more than 60 countries.
This is a dual-focus role requiring transformational vision and strict operational leadership. You will consolidate our existing FM foundation into a high-performing, data-informed ecosystem designed to minimise operational vulnerability. Through uniform service delivery standards and a consolidated regional IFM vendor model, you will drive process efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and unlock strategic business value across Merck's global footprint.
The scale of the people dimension alone is significant: this role leads a global FM organisation with a substantial team within CREM, with additional headcount transferring from business sectors as the expanded remit is stood up.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- FM Strategy & Vision: Define and own the global FM strategy for CREM — establishing a unified vision, service delivery model and operating standards across all asset classes and geographies, aligned to Merck's broader corporate objectives.
- Transformation Leadership: Lead the FM transformation programme — driving vendor consolidation toward a consolidated regional IFM model, standing up site-level governance, managing the lift-and-shift of FM services from business sectors, and embedding a performance management culture across the function.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with business sector leads, site managers and senior Merck stakeholders — positioning FM as a value-creating partner and ensuring the function is responsive to business needs.
- Operational Leadership: Ensure consistent, high-quality FM service delivery and drive operational excellence across the full portfolio by standardising service delivery and optimising facilities performance — maintaining service continuity throughout the transformation and holding Regional Heads accountable for operational performance within their geographies.
- IFM Partner Management: Own Merck's most senior relationships with global and regional IFM providers — acting as the primary Merck counterpart in strategic vendor negotiations, performance reviews and vendor [AB8.1]management at a global level.
- FM Budget Responsibility: Manage the global FM budget, allocating, monitoring, and optimising operational and capital expenditure (OpEx/CapEx) across the portfolio to ensure cost-efficiency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with corporate financial objectives.
- Budget Authority: Hold direct budget authority for FM vendor contracts and operational spend across the full scope — managing significant global FM expenditure, driving cost efficiency and ensuring financial transparency across the function.
- Standards & Compliance: Establish and enforce binding global FM standards — covering vendor protocols, preventative maintenance schedules, H&S compliance, SLAs and performance penalties. Ensure consistent application across all geographies.
- Manufacturing FM: Oversee the delivery of selected soft FM services at manufacturing sites — working in close collaboration with the Quality & Compliance Lead to ensure service delivery meets the specific operational and regulatory requirements of Merck's manufacturing environments.
- Performance Management: Establish and own the FM KPI framework — tracking performance against industry benchmarks (IFMA, RICS), driving continuous improvement and ensuring data-driven decision making is embedded across the function to achieve operational excellence.
- People Management: Lead, develop and inspire a global FM organisation — including four Regional Heads and the Quality & Compliance Lead — through a period of significant organisational change, building a high-performance culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 15–20+ years in facilities management leadership, with significant experience managing a large, complex and geographically diverse FM portfolio within a multinational corporate environment
- Demonstrated track record of leading FM transformation — vendor consolidation, IFM implementation, service standardisation and organisational change at scale
- Direct experience managing global or regional IFM partner relationships at a senior level — contract negotiation, performance management and strategic vendor governance
- Strong financial acumen — experienced in holding direct budget authority for significant FM operational spend
- Exposure to regulated environments — life sciences, Good x Practice (GxP), pharmaceutical or chemical manufacturing — strongly preferred
- Exceptional people leader — able to lead a large, diverse and geographically dispersed organisation through transformation
- Data-driven approach to FM performance — familiar with CAFM/IWMS platforms, KPI frameworks and industry benchmarking standards
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field; IFMA CFM, RICS or equivalent professional qualification advantageous

jobs.description:

As the ERP Design & Build Lead for our Life Science business, you will lead the design, governance, and continuous evolution of the global SAP S/4HANA process and system template as part of our global ERP transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, Deployment Leads, and key members of our external implementation partners, you will drive the translation of business requirements into scalable, standardized, and compliant ERP solutions while maintaining the integrity of the global template across multiple deployments. You will provide leadership throughout the design and build lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through build completion, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a high-quality, implementation-ready solution that enables successful global rollouts while preserving standardization and a clean-core architecture

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Design & Build function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the global ERP process and system template.
- Drive solution design activities, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable, standardized, and compliant SAP solutions.
- Govern design decisions and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture principles, clean-core strategy, validation requirements, and global standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the execution of design and build activities across functional workstreams and implementation partners, ensuring completeness, quality, and readiness for deployment.
- Ensure design consistency and template integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable template confirmation, solution adoption, deployment readiness, cutover planning, and issue resolution.
- Provide governance across Application Integration, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, and Platform teams to ensure an integrated, deployment-ready solution.
- Ensure ERP solutions are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements and quality standards, partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployment into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for design, build, testing readiness, defect resolution, and cutover preparation across all functional domains.
- Identify technical and functional risks early and proactively manage dependencies that could impact deployment timelines or solution quality.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, and SAP, while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP S/4HANA innovations and emerging technologies to continuously improve the global ERP template and accelerate future deployments.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools

Our research group at the University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) investigates the lung–brain axis, with a particular interest in how unique features of the lung shape both local and systemic immune responses, including immune regulation within the central nervous system. Our aim is to understand how these interactions contribute to the initiation, modulation and resolution of autoimmune neuroinflammation. Funding for this position is provided by the “UMG2032 - Excellence through Focus” project, funded by the State of Lower Saxony and the VolkswagenStiftung through the zukunft.niedersachsen program.

- Present and communicate research results at scientific meetings
- Supervision of students
